elements.text: Descriptive differences support an explanation, not a single proven cause

Input characteristic	NYU–Emerson	OCSC
Median age, years	4.58	7.22
Median words per observed turn	2	5
Turns with at most 3 words	70.07%	40.56%
Unintelligibility tokens / 1,000 words	79.49	5.73
Training words	5,336	229,378
